verdict.rationale: Buzz is a self-hostable collaboration platform, so data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no export feature, archive format, or migration path. It shows only adjacent properties: an open Nostr wire protocol that third-party clients can connect to, self-hosting on Postgres/S3, and git push/pull for hosted repos. These are protocol and hosting building blocks, not a first-party capability to export all of a user's data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
